title: RSA recipient encrypt panics on OS RNG failure — library panic
description: encrypt.rs build_rsa_recipient: the rsa crate requires CryptoRng and uses UnwrapErr(SysRng) which panics (not Err) if the OS RNG fails. A preflight getrandom::fill() check is done first, but a TOCTOU window remains. The function's doc comment correctly documents this as a panic condition, but a library should not panic on external (OS RNG) failures — only on internal programmer errors. Callers cannot catch panics without std::panic::catch_unwind. The maintenance consequence: any downstream caller on an OS with a broken RNG (rare but real on embedded or custom kernels) gets a process abort with no opportunity for graceful degradation.
